Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers. On August 21, 2026, Paul Cappuccio resigned from the Board of Directors (the “Board”) of RUM Group Inc. (the “Company”). Mr. Cappuccio informed the Company that he decided to resign from the Board so that he can focus on his responsibilities as Chief Legal Officer at Reddit, Inc., where he recently accepted an offer of employment to commence in September 2026. Mr. Cappuccio’s resignation is not the result of any disagreement with the Company on any matter related to the Company’s operations, policies, or practices. Following Mr. Cappuccio’s departure from the Board, the size of the Board has been reduced to five directors. 1 SIGNATURES Pursuant to the requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the registrant has duly caused this report to be signed on its behalf by the undersigned hereunto duly authorized.
